name: Single-Pass GPU Voxelization via 3D Texture Render Target
definition: A voxelization technique that records existence, color, and normal information in a voxel directly by setting a 3D texture as a render target, avoiding specific encoding and decoding mechanisms.
summary: Single-Pass GPU Voxelization via 3D Texture Render Target converts meshes to voxel grids in one pass using geometry shaders and 3D textures, avoiding projection artifacts and enabling real-time transparent effects.
